content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question about setting up a modbus system. In my project, I'm transitioning from using a shell (RS232) to an RS232-to-Ethernet (modbus) setup. My questions are: how do I establish communication with my [product_name], and how can I convert incoming values to represent weight? Is a network input necessary for this process? I'm new to programming and want to learn more, so any guidance would be appreciated. rs232-485-to-eth converter is being used. Greetings
Hi [user_name], [product_name] supports Ethernet, so you'll need an RS232-to-Ethernet converter to create the connection.
The scale only provides one output, which is RS232. Therefore, I need to convert it to connect to my [product_name]. Agreto-Weight-Indicator-HD1.

This topic is labeled 'Modbus to [product_name]'. Now you mention RS232. Can you clarify which is correct? Since [product_name] [version_no] supports Modbus TCP/IP. Which [product_name] version are you using? Please provide the complete [article_no].

From the scale (RS232), I use a converter that changes RS232 to LAN; this converter can also switch to Modbus. The connection then goes to my [product_name]. My question is how can I program to receive input through the Modbus protocol and convert it to a value? Sorry if that's unclear. I have two [product_name] modules: [article_no].

I believe this setup may not work. [product_name] only offers limited MODBUS capabilities—it can read digital or analog inputs, write digital and analog outputs, and access input and holding registers. However, [product_name] cannot create custom MODBUS telegrams.

I see, it's unfortunate that this solution isn't feasible. On more advanced PLCs like the S7 series, you can use RS232 cards, but that's not possible with [product_name]. Instead, you'll need to convert RS232 to analog and then feed that signal into [product_name]. LTS RS232/485 Serial-to-Analog Converter.
It's not accurate to compare [product_name] to an S7 PLC. [product_name] is a programmable logic relay, while the S7 is a full-featured automation controller.

Understood. My project involves a self-propelled mini concrete mixer. I'm using [product_name] for its compact size and because I only need a few functions: four relays and one analog output for hydraulic 0-10V control. Thank you for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members evaluated how to integrate a weight scale using RS232 output into an automation system built around [product_name] ([article_no]). They noted the [product_name]'s limited functionality with Modbus, such as not supporting custom telegrams or direct RS232 connectivity, which contrasted with the broader capabilities of some PLC models. Consequently, users discussed alternative approaches to suit the restrictions, affecting the straightforwardness of adding certain peripherals or sensors.
analysis.user_expectations: [user_name] expects [product_name] to allow easy and flexible integration with RS232-output hardware via Modbus. This would enable straightforward acquisition and conversion of data from such devices for use in automation projects.
